@graph.name: Meet Ian Vincent Rebuta in 80 seconds
@graph.description: Ian Vincent Rebuta introduces himself: where he works from, his six years with US companies, and the remote operations role he is looking for.
@graph.transcript: Hi there, my name is Ian and I'm based in Bohol, Philippines. I work remotely and I'm comfortable with US, UK or Australian hours, including night shift. For the past six years, I've supported US companies in quality assurance, documentation and back-office operations. Right now, I'm at Nooro, where I build and test AI-assisted workflows. I restructured the knowledge base behind our AI call audits, which helped our customer experience team hold a 97% satisfaction score. Before that, I managed confidential records as a document specialist at TaskUs. And at Ibex, I led a team of 23 QA analysts across three countries. I have a strong technical foundation in Salesforce, G Suite and Monday.com. As a virtual assistant, I focus on the work that keeps a business running: task tracking and follow-ups, data entry, reports, SOPs and CRM updates. I also want to free up your time by managing your calendar, inbox and the everyday admin, so you can focus on the work only you can do. My goal is to grow into a long-term operations role with a team that values reliability, and to help the business run smoother every week. Thank you so much for the opportunity to introduce myself. I'd love to support your team.

acceptedAnswer.text: Ian Vincent Rebuta is a remote operations and QA specialist, social media manager, video editor and web and AI automation builder based in Bohol, Philippines. mainEntity.name: What services does Ian Vincent Rebuta offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Four kinds of work: operations and QA (call audits, SOPs, reports, CRM follow-up), social media management (content calendars, captions, scheduling and posting), video and animation (reels, brand films and animated shorts), and web and AI automation (landing pages, web apps, AI concierges, Zapier and Google Apps Script).

mainEntity.name: Does Ian Vincent Rebuta work US hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. He works remotely from Bohol, Philippines (GMT+8) on US Eastern business hours, and has worked with US teams since 2020.

mainEntity.name: What kind of role is Ian Vincent Rebuta looking for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full-time remote role or ongoing project work with a US team, in operations, social media, video or web. He is available now.

mainEntity.name: Can he manage social media for several brands at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. He currently plans, writes, schedules and posts for ten Facebook and Instagram accounts across real estate, hobby retail, weddings, cabin rentals and more, from one GoKaizn planner, and makes the reels they post.

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Monday.com, Salesforce, GoHighLevel, Real Geeks, Zendesk, GoKaizn, Meta Business Suite, Canva, CapCut, Photoshop, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, GitHub, Vercel, Claude Code, Google AI Studio, Zapier and Google Apps Script.
